purpose: Owned development attempt references; excluded from current training and final evaluation
limitations: Single repository, six tasks, two shared code families: not independent six families.
Expected tiers are hypotheses, not measured model capability.
A passing existing test suite alone does not prove the requested change.
Two owned CLI attempts used the existing ChatGPT login; subscription quota/money and backend request counts remain unknown. No API-key/cloud job/endpoint billing was added.
Two records cover one development task: one exact-contract candidate rejection and one requested-profile support error. They are not two coding capability labels or a representative model comparison.

tasks.prompt: Design and implement an opt-in concurrent budget reservation ledger around selection. Concurrent callers must not collectively exceed a budget; release and commit must be idempotent under cancellation. Preserve the pure existing Select API.

acceptance: Race tests plus deterministic interleaving tests enforce budget conservation.
Duplicate commit/release and cancellation cannot create negative spend or double reservations.

acceptance: Race tests and controlled interleavings exercise refresh during candidate scoring and judgment.
Document the exact linearization point and in-flight revocation contract.
